name: Siverek

queries.query: Siverek Turkey official cadastral parcel map TKGM parcel query
queries.result: The official TKGM Parsel Sorgulama service was identified. Its public viewer documents parcel lookup and map display; a bounded anonymous API response was then obtained for the unchanged WUP point.

queries.result: TKGM'nin resmi Parsel Sorgulama hizmeti doğrulandı; kamuya açık görüntüleyici ve MEGSİS API'si üzerinden Siverek koordinatına bağlı güvenli parsel özelliği alındı.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: A separate Siverek district-office page or local open service was not independently evidenced; the returned record is from the national TKGM service.
regionalOrNationalSources: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM) Parsel Sorgu
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: The official national viewer and its current JavaScript configuration identify cbsapi.tkgm.gov.tr/megsiswebapi.v3.1/api as the public parcel service. The API returned a Siverek parcel feature for the exact WUP point.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GETs with the official viewer Origin/Referer headers returned HTTP 200 for the province list, Siverek district neighborhood list, exact-point parcel lookup, and administrative parcel lookup. The exact-point response and administrative lookup agreed on the same geometry and parcel identity. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.
